content_zh:
这就浪费了五个小时？
看着船夫远去的身影，方正皱了下眉头。他没想到沃森距离崔斯特姆居然会这么远，而且还是单程票———船夫可是告诉自己，他只负责送，不负责接。原本方正还有些疑惑，后来转念一想就明白了，沃森小教堂下面不是有传送阵么，那玩意儿可不比船接船送要快多了？
算了，还是先去找碎片吧。
想到这里，方正便举步向着沃森小镇内走去。
这时的沃森小镇还没有像游戏之中那样遭到邪教徒的进攻，人们还过着和平安详的生活。不时可以看见来往的渔船和在田边乡间玩耍的孩童，看见这一幕，方正也不由的有些惆怅起来。他可以想象，一旦邪教徒对这里发起进攻，那么这里几乎没有什么可以幸免。
不过可惜，现在方正是泥菩萨过江自身难保，他现在只希望自己能够以最快速度带走那块碎片，这样一来或许邪教徒就没有对沃森出手的理由，从而转移他们的视线来保全这个平静的小村落了。
方正这个外来者并没有在小镇里引起什么注意，或许是因为大多数人此刻都在忙于工作的缘故，整个小镇看起来也是平静而安详。不过方正也没有打算招惹什么事端，他迅速找到了位于镇内的教堂，然后敲开了大门。很快，一个牧师打扮的人从教堂里走出，好奇的望向方正。
“你好，陌生人，请问你来沃森有什么事吗？”
“你好，牧师。”
看着眼前的牧师，方正点了点头，接着从怀中摸出了拉姆福德队长的信递了过去。
“我是来自崔斯特姆的民兵，之前有一颗陨星掉落在了那里，我听说它有一些残片坠落在了沃森，所以想来看看有没有什么线索。”
“陨星？”
听到方正的回答，牧师愣了一下，随后恍然大悟般的点了点头。
“我知道你说的什么了，正巧，我们的确发现了一个很奇特的东西，请跟我来………”
一面说着，牧师一面侧开身体，示意方正进去。而听到牧师的说话，方正意味深长的望了他一眼，接着便走进了教堂之中。
整个教堂内一片昏暗，只有蜡烛点亮的星星点点的亮光，才能够勉强看清楚一些东西。
“究竟是什么东西？”
方正一面向着教堂内部走去，一面随口询问道。而就在这个时候，在他的身后传来了教堂大门“吱呀”一声关闭的声音。随后，牧师的声音再次响起。
“哦，是我们的渔夫在打鱼的时候捞上来的，它不时的散发出一种非常奇特的力量，渔夫不知道那是什么，就送到了教堂，我原本想要把它保管起来，但是没想到，它居然会和那颗陨星有关………”
牧师一面说着，一面死死盯着前方方正的背影。接着他伸出手去，悄无声息的从怀中掏出了一把匕首。而方正似乎对此没有丝毫察觉，他只是好奇的转头望着四周，随口询问道。

“那么，那块碎片呢？”
“就在前面………”
一面说着，牧师一面暗地里加快了脚步，他悄悄走到方正的身后，握紧手中的匕首，对准方正用力刺了过去！
而就在与此同时，一道寒光骤然闪过！
“噗嗤！”
“怎么可………能………”
牧师惊讶的瞪大眼睛，望着眼前那砍入了自己身体的冰冷剑锋，霜之哀伤的寒气四散蔓延，甚至让他都感觉到了一丝连灵魂都要被冻结的恐惧。
“你是怎么………发现………”
“演技太差，回家重练吧。”
看着眼前目瞪口呆的牧师，方正冷笑了一声。事实上，在和牧师见面的时候，方正就察觉到这个牧师不太对劲了。他望着自己的眼睛最开始充满了忧虑，而当他听到自己的来意时，他明显露出了一丝焦虑的表情，而最让方正起疑心的就是这个牧师并没有太过仔细检查拉姆福德队长的那封信，他甚至只是拆开之后草草扫了一眼，就立刻让自己进入了教堂。
方正一直很擅长察言观色，这有助于他获取信息，而现在他也正是通过这一点，来判断情况不太对经。。
而更让方正确定的，就是在进入教堂之后，这个牧师居然走在自己的后面，而不是前面。一般来说，既然是他隐藏起了那个碎片，那么他肯定要负责引路，可是他却借着关门落在自己身后，这要是没有问题才是见鬼了！

content_en:
Wasn't that five hours wasted?
Watching the boatman's retreating figure, Fang Zheng frowned. He didn't expect that Watson was so far away from Tristram, and it was a one-way ticket - but the boatman told himself that he was only responsible for delivering, not picking up. At first, Fang Zheng was a little confused, but then he thought about it and understood. Isn't there a teleportation array under the Watson Chapel? Isn't that much faster than picking up and delivering by ship?
Forget it, let’s find the fragments first.
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng walked towards Watson Town.
At this time, the town of Watson has not yet been attacked by cultists like in the game, and people are still living a peaceful and peaceful life. From time to time, you can see fishing boats passing by and children playing in the countryside beside the fields. Seeing this scene, Fang Zheng couldn't help but feel a little melancholy. He could imagine that once the cultists launched an attack here, almost nothing here would be spared.
But unfortunately, Fang Zheng is now unable to save himself from crossing the river. He only hopes that he can take away the fragment as quickly as possible. In this way, perhaps the cultists will have no reason to attack Watson, thus diverting their attention to protecting this peaceful little village.
Fang Zheng, an outsider, did not attract much attention in the town, perhaps because most people were busy working at the moment, and the whole town seemed calm and peaceful. However, Fang Zheng didn't intend to cause any trouble. He quickly found the church in the town and knocked on the door. Soon, a man dressed as a priest walked out of the church and looked at Fang Zheng curiously.
"Hello, stranger, what brings you to Watson?"
"Hello, Pastor."
Looking at the priest in front of him, Fang Zheng nodded, then took out Captain Rumford's letter from his arms and handed it over.
"I am a militiaman from Tristram. A meteorite fell there before. I heard that some fragments of it fell in Watson, so I wanted to come and see if there are any clues."
"Meteor?"
Upon hearing Fang Zheng's answer, the pastor was stunned for a moment, and then nodded as if he suddenly understood.
"I know what you are talking about. By coincidence, we did find a very strange thing. Please come with me..."
As he spoke, the pastor turned his body sideways and motioned for Fang Zheng to enter. After hearing what the pastor said, Fang Zheng gave him a meaningful look, and then walked into the church.
The whole church was dark, and only the little bits of light lit by candles could barely see something clearly.
"What exactly is it?"
Fang Zheng asked casually as he walked towards the inside of the church. At this moment, the sound of the church door closing came from behind him. Then, the priest's voice sounded again.
"Oh, it was caught by our fisherman while fishing. It exuded a very strange power from time to time. The fisherman didn't know what it was, so he sent it to the church. I originally wanted to keep it, but I didn't expect that it would be related to the meteorite..."
As the pastor spoke, he stared at the square figure in front of him. Then he stretched out his hand and quietly took out a dagger from his arms. Fang Zheng didn't seem to notice this at all. He just turned his head and looked around curiously and asked casually.
"So, where's the piece?"
"Just ahead..."
As he spoke, the priest secretly quickened his pace. He quietly walked behind Fang Zheng, clenched the dagger in his hand, and stabbed Fang Zheng hard!
And at the same time, a cold light flashed suddenly!
"Pfft!"
"How can...can...?"
The priest's eyes widened in surprise, looking at the cold sword blade that cut into his body. The cold air of Frostmourne spread in all directions, and he even felt a trace of fear that his soul would be frozen."How did you...find out..."
"My acting skills are too bad, go home and practice again."
Looking at the stunned priest in front of him, Fang Zheng sneered. In fact, when he met with the pastor, Fang Zheng noticed that something was not right with the pastor. His eyes when he looked at himself were full of worry at first, and when he heard his purpose, he showed a clear expression of anxiety. What made Fang Zheng suspicious the most was that the priest did not check Captain Rumford's letter too carefully. He even just opened it and glanced at it, and immediately let himself into the church.
Fang Zheng has always been good at observing words and expressions, which helps him obtain information, and now he uses this to judge that the situation is not right. .
What made Fang Zheng even more sure was that after entering the church, the pastor actually walked behind him instead of in front. Generally speaking, since he hid the fragment, he must be responsible for guiding the way, but he used the door to close the door and fell behind him. What a hell if there was no problem!
